facts.summary: FDA issued complete response letter, company cutting jobs · Filed (BLA resubmission) · RP1 plus nivolumab in advanced melanoma · not yet approved

evidence.summary: Replimune Receives Complete Response Letter from the FDA for RP1 Biologics License Application for the Treatment of Advanced Melanoma
evidence.safety: patients with confirmed progression on an anti-PD-1 based regimen who received RP1 plus nivolumab had a 34% response rate with a median duration of 24.8 months with a favorable safety profile.
evidence.program_discontinued: without timely accelerated approval, the development of RP1 will not be viable.
